content.value: In an epicyclic gear train, the internal wheels A and B, and the compound wheels C and D, rotate independently about axis O. The wheels E and F rotate on pins fixed to the arm G. E gears with A and C, and F gears with B and D. All the wheels have the same module, and the numbers of teeth are: $T _ { C } = 2 8 , T _ { D } = 2 6 , T _ { E } = T _ { F } = 1 8 ,$
(ii) Find the number of teeth on wheels A and B.
(iii) If the arm G makes 100 r.p.m. clockwise and A is fixed, find the speed of B.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
